ODEE-022 acceptance 1 and 4 remain unchanged. Source repair and an executed finding-plus-capability reconciliation drill are required; generic passing tests cannot waive either gate.

planningChanges.candidateBoundary: Contract proposal only. Coordinator integrates after ODEE-022 repair gate; ODEE-004 revision 2 remains the dispatch prerequisite. No runtime configuration or execution state is changed.

proposedFollowUps.title: Design bounded audit for contact, draft and original-file workflows
acceptanceBeforeDispatch: Split by one real consumer/workflow and pin actor, retention, privacy, size and recovery requirements before creating a leaf contract.

For GridFS and review-to-draft multi-record changes, explicitly choose and test durable intent/reconciliation or a capability-gated transaction strategy; never claim standalone cross-document atomic audit.
Preserve existing original-file integrity, legacy ownership, review and retry behavior; do not broaden ODEE-005 financial coverage by implication.
proposedFollowUps.rationale: Deduplicate later audit expansion under existing platform/documents/reliability epics. This metadata entry is not a schedulable ticket or evidence of delivered coverage.

tickets.title: Reconcile the committed baseline and preserve user-owned dirty work
acceptance: Record candidate/base SHA and classify original workspace dirty paths without resetting, stashing, overwriting or committing them implicitly.
Record exact existing check commands and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results; skipped Mongo/browser prerequisites are explicit, not inferred green.
Document file ownership and protected-branch/release triggers; unprotected main blocks unattended main merges until enforceable server controls are approved.
Confirm the clean worktree excludes uncommitted source changes and identify any behavior difference before claiming it as the execution baseline.

tickets.title: Isolate one worker's worktree, ports, database and original files
acceptance: Create ticket worktrees only under /home/vscode/worktrees with verified parent repository, unique branch and explicit ownership.
Two synthetic workers receive noncolliding ports, databases and original-file roots; neither inherits live URI/provider secrets or .env.local.
A cleanup/status drill identifies only owned resources, preserves unmerged work and cannot remove another worker's environment.
A refused unsafe path or unavailable resource returns an explicit failure, never an apparent ready environment.

tickets.title: Persist the bounded scheduler, revisions and start/resume/stop controls
acceptance: Reject missing IDs, dependency cycles and invalid contracts; never dispatch epic-kind entries or a leaf with unmerged prerequisites.
Persist assignments, leases, candidate/specification fingerprints, attempts and verdicts in ignored atomic JSON state with one coordinator writer.
Restart/reconcile preserves unfinished work; stale assignments and changed specifications require recovery and invalidate affected approvals.
Stop prevents new dispatch and merge even when a result arrives late; explicit resume is required after pause/stop.
A deterministic fail/fix/retest rehearsal blocks after three unsuccessful repair rounds; the CLI describes state/control rather than claiming to run autonomous agents.

tickets.title: Extract the current shell and authenticated API client without workflow changes
acceptance: Existing accounting drafts, posting, manual payments, bill scanning and contacts remain usable through the extracted shell.
A session-expiry or CSRF/origin failure produces an actionable UI state and does not retry unsafe writes silently.

The module/view registry maps / to the launcher, /accounting to Dashboard, /accounting/invoices, /accounting/bills, /accounting/journal, /accounting/accounts and /accounting/reports to their existing views, and /contacts to Contacts. No planned module gains an active route.

A direct GET and reload of each registered non-root path serves the application shell and renders the requested view after authentication without changing records; an unauthenticated deep link reveals no protected data and restores only a validated same-origin registered destination after sign-in.

In-app navigation uses native History API and the registry as its view/path authority; Back/Forward restores the correct view, closes transient selections/dialogs without submitting writes, and does not create history entries during popstate or render.

Unknown or planned-only UI paths retain an explicit not-found view with a launcher link; an HTTP 200 SPA shell is not permission or successful module activation. Reserved /api, /auth, /assets and /healthz namespaces retain their existing non-SPA error/response behavior.

Isolated browser tests cover authenticated cold deep link, reload, token/GitHub authentication return, Back/Forward, unknown/planned paths, keyboard dialogs and session expiry; all required verdicts bind the new revision and fresh candidate. No router dependency or accounting-rule change is introduced.

tickets.title: Gate existing company workflows and atomically audit posting/manual payments
acceptance: Server-created principals are github:<stable positive numeric user ID>, token:company or development:local for their respective existing modes. GitHub session/team-at-login checks, token verification, loopback/dev restrictions, origin/CSRF and content validation remain effective; another mode cannot bypass them.

A validated startup-loaded mapping explicitly grants a principal membership in the configured company ObjectID and a subset of read/write/post/admin. Duplicate conflicting grants, invalid company/principal IDs and unknown capabilities fail configuration validation. Login names, request bodies and actor IDs never supply or overwrite BSON ownership.

Default compatibility mode preserves existing authenticated read/write/post workflows without implicit admin. An explicit matching grant replaces that fallback; an explicit foreign-company grant cannot fall back into company access. Explicitly enabled enforced mode gives unmapped authenticated principals 403; missing/invalid authentication remains 401. No first-login or GitHub-team superuser is created.

All existing business reads require read; draft/contact/import/upload/scan/review-to-draft mutations require read plus write; posting and manual-payment endpoints require read plus post. Proposed GET /api/documents/{id}/audit requires read plus admin and target ownership. Capabilities do not implicitly confer one another; admin alone is not financial mutation authority.

Session discovery reports the authenticated principal's current mode, membership and capabilities without exposing other grants; existing sign-in, session expiry and available logout behavior remain usable. A membership/capability 403 presents an actionable forbidden state without logging out a valid session, granting access or silently retrying an unsafe request. UI controls mirror server decisions but direct HTTP bypasses are rejected before protected work.
Legacy owner-only records remain visible/writable only in the deterministic owner scope without backfill; nonempty canonical axes and conflicting foreign axes retain precedence.

Each successful posting/manual-payment mutation and its actor/action/target/version/time/committed-outcome event persist together in the same version- and owner-filtered document write on standalone MongoDB. Concurrency, stale writes and duplicate payment keys cannot create a second mutation or success event; uncertain writes require reconciliation rather than an invented exactly-once or neither-written claim.

Financial events are API-append-only, bounded by one posting plus the existing 200-payment limit, never silently truncated, and excluded from ordinary state/document JSON. The scoped admin audit endpoint returns only required event attribution, not tokens/hashes/secrets/CSRF, raw bodies or contact/OCR PII. Denied/failed requests never manufacture successful financial events.

Legacy documents without events remain usable and acquire attribution only for new successful actions; no historical actor is invented. Shared token/development actors identify a credential/mode, not a human. Contact/draft/upload/scan/review-to-draft audit remains explicitly proposed in PF-AUDIT-NONFINANCIAL-001, not falsely covered here.

Independent API tests cover reader, editor, poster and audit-admin sets across every existing route, all three auth modes, unmapped/wrong-company/invalid principals, expired sessions, origin/CSRF failures and canonical/legacy ownership. Isolated browser tests cover allowed/forbidden controls and direct requests, authenticated 403 versus 401 and unchanged normal workflows; mocked GitHub and synthetic data replace live services.

Real disposable standalone-Mongo tests prove post/payment and audit atomicity, race/conflict/retry behavior, existing event preservation, redaction and missing-history compatibility; memory behavior preserves the same invariants. All required verdicts bind the exact candidate and revision, with no valid existing QA criterion waived.

Human approval identifies initial admin principal(s)/explicit grants and authorizes enforced rollout before activation on any shared/live deployment. Synthetic implementation and testing use explicit fixtures and need not await live rollout approval. No real grants, configuration, migration, provider action or production activation occurs under this contract-preparation change.

authorizationContract.membershipSource: Validated startup-loaded principal/company/capability configuration; not mutable IAM or client claims.
authorizationContract.explicitGrantPolicy: A valid grant replaces fallback rights in either mode; explicit wrong-company membership denies access instead of falling back.
authorizationContract.humanGateScope: Shared/live initial-admin grants and enforced activation only; synthetic implementation/QA is permitted.

auditContract.atomicity: Single-document financial mutation plus event under current ownership/version filters; standalone MongoDB supported.
auditContract.retrieval: GET /api/documents/{id}/audit requires read plus admin and scope validation.

tickets.title: Localize the current accounting and contact journeys in English and Dutch
acceptance: Current visible accounting/contact labels, validation and conflict/error states resolve from EN/NL catalogs with no missing-key fallback presented as finished translation.
Switching locales preserves exact stored cents, quantities and ISO dates; local decimal/date display round-trips without changing request values.
Both locales pass an isolated create/review/post/payment journey with accessible names, keyboard focus and responsive layouts.

tickets.title: Add the single legal-company profile and stable partner snapshots
acceptance: Validate and expose one legal company's name, address, enterprise/VAT identifiers and payment/bank metadata with explicit unsupported applicability values.
Selecting a saved contact copies a versioned accounting snapshot with stable contact reference; later contact edit/archive cannot change a posted document.
Customer/vendor payment/tax metadata is permission-scoped; imported Odoo IDs remain provenance, never ownership.
Invalid identifiers and stale writes produce explicit errors in both locales without dropping the existing contact profile.

tickets.title: Configure one chart, journals and fiscal year while preserving starter accounts
acceptance: One company can review and maintain validated account/journal/fiscal-year configuration; invalid account types or overlapping periods cannot be activated.
Historical starter-chart entries retain codes, amounts and interpretation when a new Belgian mapping is selected.
Posting rejects missing/inactive configured mappings instead of guessing accounts; independently calculated balanced fixtures remain correct.
Belgian PCMN/MAR mapping references and unresolved accountant decisions are recorded; activation for statutory use is not inferred from passing software tests.

tickets.title: Introduce an exact versioned quantity, discount and tax calculation policy
acceptance: A documented fixed-scale quantity/price/discount policy rejects overflow and invalid precision and never computes ledger money with binary floating point.
Independent fixtures cover fractional quantities, discount boundaries, mixed rates and explicit line/document rounding adjustments.
The synthetic 2 x EUR100.00 plus 21 percent case yields net 20000, VAT 4200, total 24200 cents consistently in API and UI.
Existing posted totals and prior rounding policy are preserved; changing policy cannot recalculate historical records.

tickets.title: Allocate legal invoice numbers with concurrency and recovery safety
acceptance: A source-linked, reviewable sequence policy defines journal/year scope, reservation, cancellation and uncertain-write recovery without assuming ObjectID references are legal numbers.
Concurrent or retried posting gives one authoritative posted document and number, balanced entries and explicit conflict/replay semantics; numbers are not reused.
Crash/unknown-result tests reconcile durable reservation/posting state with no unexplained silent gap or false success.
Any required replica-set transaction capability is explicitly gated and cannot silently break existing standalone-compatible flows.

tickets.title: Correct one posted invoice through linked credit/reversal and fiscal-lock rules
acceptance: Full and partial credit-note journeys preserve the original posted snapshot and produce auditable reversal links and independently balanced entries.
For a 24200-cent invoice paid 10000 cents, credit/refund/allocation fixtures reconcile the remaining 14200 cents without creating an accidental bank transfer or duplicate refund.
A closed-period mutation is rejected server-side; only the declared capability can perform an audited reopen/correction transition.
Duplicate correction requests cannot over-credit; debit-note scenarios outside the accepted initial policy return an explicit unsupported outcome.

For an immutable posted invoice of two EUR100.00 units plus 21 percent VAT (24200 cents), after a 10000-cent payment, one reviewed credit note for one unit is 12100 cents and leaves 2100 cents receivable when allocated. Retrying correction/allocation cannot create another credit or repeat allocation; no automatic cash refund or edit of the original is implied.

tickets.title: Preview an English or Dutch invoice PDF and local delivery intent
acceptance: An EN and NL PDF fixture includes the reviewed legal company/partner snapshot, invoice number/dates, terms, item/tax breakdown and totals matching the stored ledger.
Locale changes affect presentation only; escaped untrusted text cannot alter document structure or expose another scope's original file.
A local preview/queue records delivery intent and error/retry states but cannot send real email or imply Peppol delivery.
Required legal fields and outstanding professional review are visible; a PDF is not represented as satisfying structured B2B e-invoicing.

tickets.title: Evaluate certified Access Points and define one mocked adapter contract
acceptance: A public primary-source checklist compares certified-provider sandbox, inbound access, payload formats, authentication, idempotency, status/unknown-send semantics and commercial prerequisites.
One offline adapter contract defines participant IDs, send/poll/callback states, raw payload retention and synthetic request/response examples without assuming a paid provider is approved.
Provider signup, secrets, registration, spend and sandbox/production network calls remain blocked pending explicit human authorization.
Unavailable provider evidence is marked unverified and does not block unrelated safe finance work.

tickets.title: Serialize and validate synthetic outbound UBL invoice and credit note offline
acceptance: Pin applicable UBL/BIS schemas, rules, code lists, release identifiers and validator artifact checksums; the observed May 2026 BIS landing-page label alone is insufficient conformance evidence.
Independent valid and invalid invoice/credit-note fixtures verify totals, taxes, participant identifiers, original-invoice references and actionable rule diagnostics without network transport.
Serialize only supported versioned tax/quantity policies; unsupported exemption/reverse-charge cases fail explicitly instead of emitting guessed compliant XML.
Generated XML reconciles to immutable accounting snapshots and its original artifact is preserved with scoped access.

tickets.title: Recover one mocked outbound transport intent with explicit delivery diagnostics
acceptance: A durable intent/outbox and stable provider key survive restart/retry without an untracked duplicate send.
Mock accepted/rejected/duplicate/unknown-result responses have distinct diagnostics and a reconciliation path; HTTP acceptance is never labelled final delivery.
Accounting posting, payment and transport statuses remain separate and visible in both locales.
Default tests perform no production transport; any authorized sandbox receipt is separately recorded and its absence cannot be described as a completed exchange.

tickets.title: Quarantine and review one replay-safe inbound invoice or credit-note payload
acceptance: Authenticate synthetic callbacks/polling results, preserve one scoped raw XML original and record transport/business identifiers and provenance.
Malformed, oversized, unsafe XML or invalid participant/tax data is quarantined with diagnostics and cannot create an authorized payable.
Duplicate/out-of-order delivery including after restart creates at most one linked review-to-bill or credit-note draft.
Supplier resolution requires explicit review on ambiguity; receipt never auto-posts, auto-pays or reassigns ownership from external IDs.
Validation artifacts/rules are pinned independently even though the approved graph permits this slice before outbound serialization.

tickets.title: Reconcile one opening-balance and date-filtered reporting journey
acceptance: A balanced opening journal plus dated invoice/payment/credit fixtures yields independently expected opening, activity and closing amounts.
Date-filtered ledger, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet and receivable/payable aging reconcile to the same scoped posted records.
Report boundaries, due-date aging, fiscal close and reversal cases are explicit; drafts cannot silently enter posted totals.
Existing cumulative report behavior remains compatible or is explicitly versioned; queries and exported ranges have documented bounded limits.

tickets.title: Match one synthetic bank statement and preview reviewed domestic VAT grids
acceptance: A single-bank-journal documented import format with synthetic opening/closing balances rejects duplicate statement/line keys and malformed rows without partial hidden success.
Manual matching and undo for invoice/payment fixtures reconcile statement and ledger totals across retry; this records accounting movement and never initiates a transfer.
A separately reviewable domestic 21-percent invoice/bill VAT mapping and export-preview fixture has source-linked grid expectations and accountant-review gating.
Unsupported statement formats, tax regimes and statutory filings are explicitly refused; broader CODA/ISO20022 and VAT cases remain parent-epic slices, not implicit scope.

tickets.title: Rehearse the first integrated accounting/Peppol candidate without releasing
acceptance: Run fresh merged-candidate checks and a persistent authenticated EN/NL contact-to-invoice/correction/payment/report and mocked Peppol journey on isolated resources.
Restore a disposable backup and reconcile ledger, ownership, original files, sequence and transport intent; missing restore evidence blocks the candidate.
Demonstrate the feedback/revision loop, duplicate finding coalescing, invalidated QA and stop/resume behavior on the current candidate.
Hand the human candidate SHA, exact verdicts, known gaps, accountant/provider decisions, runtime requirements and rollback notes; do not create release tags, images, filings or production sends.

tickets.title: Define PM authority, roadmap revisions and source-linked feedback decisions
acceptance: The roadmap distinguishes PM product priority/revision authority from coordinator execution-state/merge authority and independent tester verdicts.
A feedback packet identifies finding, ticket revision, exact SHA, reproducer, expected/actual behavior, sources, decision, changed dependencies and invalidated verdicts.
Illustrated in-scope feature addition and out-of-scope/spend escalation preserve accounting-first, Belgium, EN/NL, one-company and human-release boundaries.
The versioned backlog has concrete nonempty acceptance, valid dependencies and non-dispatchable full-suite parent epics; it makes no execution-completion claim.

tickets.title: Verify stable official Odoo references and accounting/contact capability gaps
acceptance: Official documentation entry, support/release evidence and edition comparison identify the verified stable release with exact URLs, retrieval date/method and confidence; master and annual guesses are excluded.
The matrix distinguishes Community Invoicing, public Enterprise Comprehensive Accounting and edition-unspecified guide details, including Community Peppol registration where explicitly documented.
Accounting/contact gaps reference the inspected committed source baseline and linked tickets without treating dirty workspace changes or unrun tests as verified parity.
Unavailable/new sources remain unverified and block only dependent claims; Belgian authority/standards and professional review override simplified Odoo wording.

tickets.title: Bind PM feedback revisions and capability gaps to bounded scheduling and resume
acceptance: A tester finding and one documented in-scope capability gap produce a deduplicated planning delta with source/finding links and explicit ticket revision.
A changed acceptance/dependency contract pauses incompatible work, preserves its handoff and invalidates affected exact-SHA/spec verdicts before redispatch.
A valid failing test cannot be waived by PM reprioritization, relabelled capability status or an unchanged candidate approval.
Status/resume reports pinned Odoo reference, PM changes, ready/blocked leaves and next safe work; epics and missing evidence never count as completed work.
No new work or merge is permitted after stop; execution-state updates remain coordinator-only.

tickets.title: Make the source-linked planning rehearsal portable across current contract revisions
acceptance: The D013/D014 finding/capability rehearsal remains linked to the real planning records, capability matrix and official-source credit-note discovery. Claims, submissions, required QA roles, gates and merge records use the selected current fixture ticket's actual revision/roles rather than assuming every dependent is revision 1.

Preserve all existing valid failure, BLOCKED/no-waiver, candidate/specification invalidation, failure/checkpoint/lease retention, repeated-packet deduplication, stop/resume and stale-gate rejection assertions. Do not repair by relaxing production claim validation, dropping negative cases or reverting ODEE-005 revision 2.

Regression cases exercise legitimate ODEE-005 revision 2 and later added/revised unrelated leaves, including changed required QA roles. Ticket/leaf/epic counts and readiness expectations derive from the fixture manifest and intended invariants rather than fixed 69/22/47 totals or incidental unrelated queue order.

If current roadmap files are loaded, diagnostics identify a current-manifest synthetic rehearsal and its reconstructed target revisions, not an exact historical 6549b611 or 21c4c43 snapshot. Any exact historical-content claim must actually use that immutable content; all fixture worker/SHA/merge records remain explicitly synthetic.

Independent qa-api-data and qa-integration rerun node --test tools/agents/loop-planning.test.mjs tools/agents/qa-loop.test.mjs on the exact new candidate/revision and verify the source-linked, metamorphic and unchanged negative assertions. Record broader root-check results and unrelated failures honestly; a passing focused rehearsal alone is not all-root-green evidence.

In both test files derive expected current ticket/leaf/epic totals from the validated fixture/current backlog rather than hardcoding 69/22/47 or removing count assertions. The independent real-backlog initialization test retains schema validation, complete initialized ticket/count expectations, zero fabricated merges/candidates/gates/workers/QA, non-dispatchable epics and exact preservation of accepted backlog metadata/extensions. Verify these invariants still hold when an unrelated legitimate leaf is added or revised.
tickets.observedFailure: STALE_REVISION: expected revision 2, received 1; dependent claim at loop-planning.test.mjs:138.
tickets.additionalObservedFailure: 70 !== 69 at qa-loop.test.mjs:106 after the legitimate ODEE-023 manifest addition; same portability defect, now covered by revision 2.

tickets.title: Baseline and integration safety
acceptance: Decompose and reconcile baseline/controls into bounded leaves; retain dirty work and exact-SHA check evidence before parallel implementation.

tickets.title: Agent operating system
acceptance: Split durable control/dispatch/merge work into bounded leaves and demonstrate fail/fix/retest, explicit resume and stop-before-merge drills.

tickets.title: Platform access and modular shell
acceptance: Decompose role enforcement, membership, navigation/client extraction and actor audit; unauthorized actions fail server-side while current journeys remain usable.

tickets.title: English/Dutch and accessible controls
acceptance: Split locale/catalog/document work into bounded journeys; both locales preserve exact contracts and pass keyboard/accessibility checks.

tickets.title: Isolated reproducible testing
acceptance: Decompose isolated persistent/OAuth/browser fixtures and exact-SHA CI evidence; concurrent workers cannot reset each other's data and require no live credentials.

tickets.title: Adaptive product management
acceptance: Split PM research/revision integration into leaves and show a source-linked tester/gap decision without bypassing QA, authority or execution-state ownership.

tickets.title: Legal company and contacts
acceptance: Decompose legal metadata, bank/terms/relationships, duplicates, pagination and import reports; stable references and posted snapshots survive contact edit/archive without provenance-based ownership.

tickets.title: Ledger, Belgian chart and configuration
acceptance: Split validated charts/journals, fiscal years, opening balances and manual journals; historical accounts remain interpretable and every posting reconciles independently.

tickets.title: Invoice, correction and fiscal-lock lifecycle
acceptance: Split precision/discount policy, legal numbering, credit/debit corrections, reversals, payment terms and locks; races/retries preserve one immutable accounting result with reviewed sequence policy.

tickets.title: Business documents, receivables and payables
acceptance: Decompose EN/NL PDF, attachments, delivery intents, dunning/aging and credit/refund allocations; documents reconcile to ledger and messages stay local until authorized.

tickets.title: Banking, reconciliation and expenses
acceptance: Split bank journals, CODA/appropriate ISO20022 imports, deduplication, matching/write-offs and expense approvals into reviewed format/workflow leaves; statements reconcile without initiating transfers.

tickets.title: Belgian tax, reporting and close
acceptance: Decompose effective-dated VAT, exemptions/reverse-charge/intra-EU/deductibility, reviewed grids/listings, financial reports and close/reopen permissions; professional review is separate from preview/export and no filing is implicit.

tickets.title: Peppol outbound
acceptance: Split Access Point contract, participant rules, UBL invoice/credit note validation and recoverable queue/diagnostics; tax policy and offline conformance precede authorized sandbox exchange, never automatic live registration.

tickets.title: Peppol inbound
acceptance: Split authenticated receive, preserved XML, quarantine, supplier review and transport diagnostics; adapter contract and replay tests guarantee one reviewed draft with no auto-post/payment.

tickets.title: Accounting operational readiness
acceptance: Decompose exports, retention, restore, permissions, Odoo import reconciliation and cutover checks; accountant/provider acceptance and human release remain explicit independent gates.

tickets.title: Shared product and service catalog
acceptance: Research and split products/services, categories, units, tax defaults, prices, variants, archiving and supplier/customer references; sales/purchase/stock share stable definitions without changing historical snapshots.

tickets.title: CRM leads and opportunities
acceptance: Split leads, stages, activities/teams, notes and won/lost reasons; one lead-to-customer journey enforces access and deduplicated contact conversion.

tickets.title: Quotations, orders and invoicing policies
acceptance: Split quotes, prices/discounts, terms, deposits, orders, cancellation/returns and portal acceptance; retry-safe order invoicing uses finance services and delivered-stock policies wait for S2.

tickets.title: Recurring subscriptions
acceptance: Split recurring agreements, schedules/proration, renewals, cancellation and arrears; fixed-clock/restart tests produce one invoice per accepted billing occurrence.

tickets.title: Rental reservations and returns
acceptance: Split availability/reservations, checkout/return, deposits, late charges and damages; concurrent bookings cannot double-reserve and invoice/return totals reconcile.

tickets.title: Helpdesk and repairs
acceptance: Split queues/SLAs, knowledge, portal intake and repair/service billing; role-safe support-to-resolution passes and parts-consuming leaves add S2 as a prerequisite.

tickets.title: Point of sale
acceptance: Split till sessions, cash/card recording, receipts, returns and stock/ledger linkage; fiscal applicability is reviewed and hardware/payments remain gated rather than assuming Belgian certification.

tickets.title: Purchasing and vendor fulfillment
acceptance: Split vendor prices, RFQ/PO approval, partial fulfillment, three-way match and returns; order/receipt/bill discrepancies remain visible and receipt-integrated leaves depend on S2.

tickets.title: Inventory and barcode
acceptance: Split locations, moves, reservations, receipts/deliveries, lots/serials, units, transfers, counts, traceability and barcode; concurrent reservations and corrections preserve independently reconciled quantities.

tickets.title: Valuation and replenishment
acceptance: Split reviewed valuation policy, landed costs, replenishment/demand, returns/scrap and stock-ledger reconciliation; partial receipts/corrections reconcile quantity and value without duplicate postings.

tickets.title: Manufacturing
acceptance: Split BOMs, work centers, production/work orders, consumption, finished goods, scrap/by-products and cost rollups; one reviewed production journey reconciles components, outputs and value.

tickets.title: Quality, maintenance and PLM
acceptance: Split quality/nonconformance, equipment/maintenance and engineering-change/BOM effectivity; configured quality holds block transitions and historical orders retain their accepted BOM revision.

tickets.title: Projects and tasks
acceptance: Split projects/milestones, task boards/dependencies, assignments, file/activity links and customer visibility; cross-project and portal authorization are independently tested.

tickets.title: Timesheets and resource planning
acceptance: Split time capture/approval, capacity/schedules, billable policy and leave integration; approved time is billed once, allocation conflicts are visible, and leave-dependent leaves wait for H3.

tickets.title: Service billing and profitability
acceptance: Split fixed/milestone/time-material billing and analytic dimensions/budgets/margins; independent fixtures reconcile invoice, approved time, expenses and costs.

tickets.title: Field service and appointments
acceptance: Split bookable services, technician schedules, worksheets, travel/parts and completion/billing; prevent booking conflicts and preserve acceptance audit, with S2 added to parts-consuming leaves.

tickets.title: Employees and organization
acceptance: Split directory/departments, contract metadata, onboarding/offboarding and private HR files; employee/private data cannot leak through contacts, portal or general attachment access.

tickets.title: Recruitment
acceptance: Split jobs/applicants, interviews/evaluations/offers and retention/consent; applicant conversion retains provenance and requires explicit private-data permissions.

tickets.title: Attendance, leave, appraisals and skills
acceptance: Split calendars/attendance correction, leave entitlement/approval, appraisals, skills and referrals; fixed-clock/time-zone fixtures reconcile balances and approved leave can inform planning.

tickets.title: Belgian payroll-provider integration
acceptance: Split approved-provider export/import, pay-run review, private payslips and journal linkage after professional contract/rule validation; do not implement or claim a certified home-grown payroll engine.

tickets.title: Fleet and workplace
acceptance: Split vehicles/contracts/costs, maintenance links, visits and workplace requests where useful; personal details stay restricted and cost flows remain auditable.

tickets.title: Website and customer portal
acceptance: Split public content/navigation/SEO, forms/languages and authorized document/order/ticket portal journeys; public/portal identity is separate from internal GitHub membership.

tickets.title: Ecommerce
acceptance: Split catalog publication, cart/checkout, tax/shipping, sandbox payments, orders and refunds/returns; duplicate callbacks create neither duplicate orders, stock movement nor revenue.

tickets.title: Marketing and feedback
acceptance: Split segmentation/campaigns, consent/unsubscribe, automation and surveys; synthetic local delivery respects consent, and SMS/social/WhatsApp adapters wait for approved providers.

tickets.title: Events, learning and appointments
acceptance: Split event registration/tickets/capacity, courses/enrollment/progress and booking links; authorization/refunds reconcile and appointment leaves add P4 before scheduling.

tickets.title: Documents and knowledge
acceptance: Extract shared attachments only with a second real consumer; split folders/tags/versioning/previews/knowledge search while preserving original bills, authorization, retention and restore.

tickets.title: Activities and collaboration
acceptance: Split inbox/notifications, mentions, shared calendar, discuss/comments and assignments when consumed; read/delivery states are tested and cross-scope visibility is denied.

tickets.title: Approvals and signatures
acceptance: Split explicit approval/delegation and auditable acceptance with real consumers; prohibit self-approval where required and gate signature-provider use without qualified-signature claims.

tickets.title: Reporting and dashboards
acceptance: Split scoped aggregates, saved reports, drill-down, dashboards and exports per consumer; bounded queries reconcile to source records without arbitrary spreadsheet execution.

tickets.title: APIs, imports and integrations
acceptance: Split versioned APIs, CSV/Odoo mapping previews, jobs/outbox and webhook retry/dead-letter tools; dry-run/error reports reconcile scope and replay-safe changes without modifying original sources.

tickets.title: Controlled customization
acceptance: After core contracts stabilize, split validated custom fields/views and bounded automation; every customization retains accounting/access validation and cannot execute arbitrary code.

tickets.title: Reliability and administration
acceptance: Split health/metrics/audit diagnostics, backups/recovery, job control, dependencies and measured performance budgets; recovery drills pass and incomplete work never appears successful.
